task1.title: Housing types in city areas
task1.prompt: The table below shows the percentage of the population and the types of houses they live in 3 areas of a city.

chartDesc.xAxis: Types of housing (Flat/Apartment, Terraced, Semi-Detached, Detached)
chartDesc.yAxis: Areas of the city and their total population
chartDesc.overview: While all three areas have roughly equal populations (around 31,700 to 32,100), the predominant housing type varies significantly by area: Green Park is dominated by flats/apartments, Southberg by terraced houses, and the Central area by detached and semi-detached houses.
keyFeatures: Green Park area has the highest proportion of flat/apartment dwellers at 76%, whereas only 5% live in semi-detached and 5% in detached homes.
Southberg Area has a major concentration in terraced housing at 56%, with semi-detached housing being the lowest at 5%.
Central area has the highest proportion of detached houses (39%) and semi-detached houses (28%) among all areas, with flats/apartments being its lowest category at 15%.
Total population is very similar across all three regions: Central area (32,100), Southberg Area (32,000), and Green Park area (31,700).

task1.instruction: Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
task1.sampleBand5:
The table give information about the percentage of people and their houses in three areas. It shows what kinds of houses people live in.

Looking at the table, we can see that most people live in detached houses in area A. In area B, the number of people in semi-detached houses is bigger. Area C has more people in flats than the other areas. The other types of houses are not very popular.

In area A, 60% of people live in detached houses. This is a lot. Only 15% live in flats. In area B, 45% live in semi-detached houses. This is the biggest number. The number of people in detached houses and flats are similar. Area C is a bit different. About 40% of people live in flats, which is more than the others.

Overall, the table tells us where people choose to live in these different areas and the types of houses they like.

In the city center, apartments are the most common, with 65% of the population living in them. Houses are less common at 25%, and only 10% live in townhouses. In the suburbs, the most popular housing type is houses, with 55% of people living in them. Apartments are less popular at 30%, and townhouses account for 15%. Regarding the rural area, houses are even more popular, with 70% of the population living in them. Apartments are not as common, with only 15%, and townhouses make up the remaining 15%.

It is also noticeable that apartments are more popular in the city center, while houses are the preferred choice in the suburbs and rural area. Townhouses are not very common in any of the three areas, but they have a slightly larger percentage in the suburbs and rural area compared to the city center.

task1.sampleAnswer:
The table provides information about the proportion of the population living in various types of housing across three distinct areas of a city.

Overall, it is clear that housing preferences vary significantly between the three areas. Detached houses are most common in Area A, while flats and apartments dominate in Area C. Area B shows a more balanced distribution across housing types.

Looking at the data in more detail, Area A has the highest percentage of residents living in detached houses, at 46%, compared to just 10% in Area C. Conversely, Area C has the largest share of people residing in flats and apartments, accounting for 52% of its population, whereas this figure is considerably lower in Area A at only 12%.

In Area B, the population is more evenly spread across different housing types, with terraced houses being the most popular at 34%, followed by semi-detached houses at 28%. Meanwhile, semi-detached houses are the second most common type in Area A at 24%, but represent only 15% of housing in Area C. Terraced houses make up 18% of the housing in Area A and 23% in Area C.

In summary, Area A is characterised by a preference for larger, independent dwellings, while Area C residents tend to live in smaller, multi-unit accommodation, and Area B occupies a middle ground between the two.

Jadval uchta hududdagi odamlar va ularning uylari foizi haqida ma'lumot beradi. Unda odamlarning qanday uylarda yashashi ko'rsatilgan.

Jadvalga qarasak, A hududida ko'pchilik odamlar alohida uylarda yashashini ko'rishimiz mumkin. B hududida yarim alohida uylarda yashovchi odamlar soni ko'proq. C hududida boshqa hududlarga qaraganda kvartiralarda yashovchi odamlar ko'p. Uylarning boshqa turlari unchalik mashhur emas.

A hududida odamlarning 60 foizi alohida uylarda yashaydi. Bu juda ko'p. Faqat 15 foizi kvartiralarda yashaydi. B hududida 45 foizi yarim alohida uylarda yashaydi. Bu eng katta raqam. Alohida uylarda va kvartiralarda yashovchi odamlar soni bir xil. C hududi biroz farq qiladi. Odamlarning taxminan 40 foizi kvartiralarda yashaydi, bu boshqalardan ko'ra ko'proq.

Umuman olganda, jadval bizga odamlarning ushbu turli hududlarda qayerda yashashni tanlashlari va ularga qanday uylar yoqishi haqida ma'lumot beradi.

Shahar markazida kvartiralar eng keng tarqalgan bo'lib, aholining 65% ularda yashaydi. Uylar kamroq tarqalgan – 25%, va faqat 10% tounhauslarda yashaydi. Shahar atrofida eng mashhur uy-joy turi bu uylar bo'lib, odamlarning 55% ularda yashaydi. Kvartiralar 30% bilan kamroq mashhur, va tounhauslar 15% ni tashkil qiladi. Qishloq hududiga kelsak, uylar yanada mashhurroq, aholining 70% ularda yashaydi. Kvartiralar bunday keng tarqalmagan, faqat 15%, va tounhauslar qolgan 15% ni tashkil etadi.

Shuningdek, kvartiralar shahar markazida ko'proq mashhurligi, uylar esa shahar atrofi va qishloq hududida afzal ko'rilishi sezilarli. Tounhauslar unchalik keng tarqalmagan uchta hududning hech birida, lekin ularning foiz ko'rsatkichi shahar markaziga nisbatan shahar atrofi va qishloq hududida biroz yuqoriroq.

B hududida aholining faqat 5% boshqa turar joylarda yashaydi. Aksincha, C hududi yanada muvozanatli taqsimotni ko'rsatadi, 45% kvartiralarda va 40% uylarda yashaydi. Boshqa turar joylarda yashovchi shaxslarning foizi ushbu hududda eng yuqori bo'lib, 15% ni tashkil qiladi.

"Boshqa" toifasi doimiy ravishda eng kam uchraydigan hisoblanadi, garchi hududlar bo'ylab biroz o'zgarish bo'lsa ham.

Biroq, kvartiralar sezilarli farqni namoyish etadi, A hududida turar joylarning 35% ni tashkil qiladi, ammo B hududida 25% ga va C hududida atigi 15% ga tushadi. Bu shuni ko'rsatadiki, hudud va uy-joy zichligi o'rtasida bog'liqlik bo'lishi mumkin, A hududi potentsial ravishda ko'proq urbanizatsiya qilingan va C hududi esa ko'proq shahar atrofi.

Xulosa qilib aytganda, uy-joy imtiyozlari va mavjudligi shahar bo'ylab aniq geografik tendentsiyani namoyon etadi, alohida uylar afzalroq variant bo'lib, ayniqsa C hududida, kvartiralar esa A hududida ko'proq tarqalgan. B hududi uy-joy turini taqsimlash bo'yicha oraliq pozitsiyani egallaydi. Alohida uylar va kvartiralar o'rtasidagi teskari bog'liqlik ham e'tiborga loyiq.

task2.title: Children and computer games
task2.prompt: Today many children spend a lot of time playing computer games and little time on sports. Is it a positive or negative development?
task2.instruction: Discuss both sides and give your own opinion. Give reasons for your answer and include relevant examples from your own knowledge or experience. Write at least 250 words.
task2.sampleBand5:
Nowadays, many children like playing computer games. They spend a lot of time playing these games instead of doing sports. I think there are both good and bad things about this.

On the one hand, playing computer games can be good. It can help children to learn new things. Some games are about solving problems, and this can make children smarter. Also, they can make friends with other people who play the same games online. This can be good for their social life, even if they are not meeting in person. My brother, for example, plays a lot of strategy games, and he says it helps him think better. He also talks to his teammates online and they help each other.

On the other hand, playing too many computer games can be bad. Children might not get enough exercise if they are always sitting down playing games. This can make them unhealthy. Also, some games are very violent, and this can affect children in a bad way. They might become aggressive or have trouble sleeping. For example, my neighbour's son plays very violent games, and he sometimes shouts and gets angry very easily.

In my opinion, it is important for children to do both computer games and sports. They should not spend too much time on one thing. It is better to have a balance. Parents should help their children to find this balance. They can limit the time that children spend on computer games and encourage them to play sports or do other activities. If children have a good balance, they can enjoy the benefits of both computer games and sports without the bad effects.
task2.sampleBand6:
In today's world, it is becoming more common for children to spend a significant amount of time playing computer games, while spending less time participating in sports. This trend has both positive and negative aspects which need to be considered.

On the one hand, there are some benefits to this increased engagement with computer games. Firstly, many games can help to improve children's problem-solving skills and strategic thinking. For example, strategy games require players to plan ahead and make decisions that affect the outcome of the game. Secondly, some games can be educational, teaching children about history, science, or other subjects. Also, with the development of technology, many games offer opportunities for children to connect with other players online, fostering social interaction and teamwork, although this can be a bit risky if not monitored.

However, there are also several drawbacks to spending too much time playing computer games. One major concern is the impact on physical health. Children who spend hours sitting in front of a screen are less likely to get the exercise they need, which can lead to obesity and other health problems. Furthermore, excessive gaming can be addictive and can lead to social isolation. Children may neglect their schoolwork, hobbies, and relationships with family and friends if they are too focused on gaming. Finally, some games contain violent content, which can have a negative impact on children's behaviour and attitudes.

In conclusion, while there are some potential benefits to playing computer games, such as improved cognitive skills and social interaction, the negative effects on physical health and social development are more significant. In my opinion, it is important for parents to encourage their children to participate in a range of activities, including sports, to ensure a healthy and well-rounded development. A balance is definitely needed.
task2.sampleBand7:
In contemporary society, an increasing number of children are dedicating a significant portion of their time to playing computer games, often at the expense of engaging in sports. While this trend raises concerns, it is not entirely negative, as it presents both drawbacks and potential benefits, which I will explore before offering my perspective.

On the one hand, the reduced participation in sports is undeniably detrimental to children's physical health. A sedentary lifestyle, characterised by prolonged periods of sitting and limited physical activity, can contribute to obesity, cardiovascular problems, and other health issues. Furthermore, sports offer valuable opportunities for developing teamwork skills, discipline, and resilience – qualities that are difficult to cultivate through solitary computer gaming. For example, my younger brother, who spends hours each day playing video games, struggles to maintain a healthy weight and often finds it challenging to cooperate with others in group activities.

However, the increasing popularity of computer games also has its advantages. Many modern games are not simply mindless entertainment; they can enhance cognitive skills such as problem-solving, strategic thinking, and hand-eye coordination. Some educational games can even supplement classroom learning by making complex concepts more accessible and engaging. Moreover, online gaming platforms often connect children with peers from different backgrounds and cultures, fostering a sense of global community and improving communication skills. While not a direct parallel, I have observed that some of my students who are avid gamers often demonstrate quick thinking and adaptability in problem-solving tasks.

In conclusion, while the decline in sports participation among children is a valid concern due to its potential impact on physical health and social development, the rise of computer gaming is not without its merits. It can offer cognitive benefits and opportunities for online social interaction. Ultimately, the key lies in achieving a balanced approach, where children can enjoy the benefits of both physical activity and digital entertainment. I believe that parents and educators should encourage children to engage in a variety of activities, ensuring that they develop both physically and mentally.
task2.sampleBand8:
The increasing amount of time children dedicate to computer games, often at the expense of sports, is a trend that elicits both concern and acceptance. While there are undeniable drawbacks, the potential benefits of this shift warrant careful consideration. I believe that, on balance, this development presents more negative consequences, although the positive aspects should not be dismissed.

On the one hand, the allure of digital entertainment offers certain advantages. Notably, many modern games require strategic thinking and problem-solving skills. Children engaging with these games can hone their cognitive abilities, develop their reflexes, and even improve their teamwork when participating in online multiplayer games. Furthermore, exposure to diverse virtual environments can broaden their horizons and foster creativity. For instance, simulation games like "Minecraft" encourage players to build and design, nurturing their imagination and spatial reasoning. However, these benefits are often overstated and do not compensate for the potential downsides.

Conversely, the sedentary nature of excessive gaming poses significant risks to children's physical and mental well-being. A lack of physical activity can lead to obesity, cardiovascular problems, and other health issues. Moreover, the immersive nature of computer games can be addictive, leading to social isolation, anxiety, and depression. Children who spend excessive time gaming may neglect their studies, family relationships, and other important aspects of their lives. For example, a recent study by the American Academy of Pediatrics linked excessive screen time to increased rates of childhood depression and anxiety. Furthermore, the potential for exposure to violent or inappropriate content raises serious safeguarding concerns. It is therefore imperative that parents monitor their children's gaming habits and encourage a balanced lifestyle.

In conclusion, while computer games can offer some cognitive and creative benefits, the potential negative impacts on children's physical and mental health, as well as their social development, are more significant. The risks of a sedentary lifestyle, addiction, and exposure to harmful content outweigh the advantages. Therefore, this trend towards increased gaming and decreased participation in sports is, in my opinion, a largely negative development. A concerted effort is needed to promote a healthier balance between digital entertainment and physical activity, ensuring the well-being of future generations. Striking this balance is crucial for fostering well-rounded individuals.
task2.sampleBand9:
The increasing prevalence of computer games among children, often at the expense of participation in sports, is a multifaceted trend with both potential advantages and disadvantages. While concerns about sedentary lifestyles and social isolation are valid, it is also important to acknowledge the cognitive and developmental benefits that well-designed computer games can offer. On balance, however, I believe the shift towards computer games carries more negative implications than positive ones.

On one hand, the appeal of computer games is understandable. Many games offer engaging challenges that can enhance problem-solving skills, strategic thinking, and even hand-eye coordination. For instance, real-time strategy games require players to manage resources, plan attacks, and react quickly to changing circumstances, thereby sharpening their cognitive abilities. Furthermore, online multiplayer games can foster a sense of community and collaboration, allowing children to interact with peers from diverse backgrounds and develop teamwork skills. My own nephew, initially introverted, gained confidence and improved his communication skills through participating in an online gaming community centered around a collaborative world-building game. He learnt to articulate his ideas persuasively and negotiate solutions with others.

However, the potential downsides of excessive computer game consumption are significant. The most obvious concern is the impact on physical health. Spending hours sitting in front of a screen reduces opportunities for physical activity, increasing the risk of obesity, cardiovascular problems, and other health issues. More subtly, the immersive nature of gaming can lead to social isolation, as children may prioritize virtual interactions over real-world relationships. A further worry is the exposure to violent or age-inappropriate content, which can desensitize children to violence and negatively influence their behavior. A recent study by the American Psychological Association underscores the correlation between prolonged exposure to violent video games and increased aggression in adolescents.

In conclusion, while computer games can offer certain cognitive and social benefits, the potential risks to physical health, social development, and psychological well-being outweigh these advantages. It is therefore crucial for parents and educators to encourage a balanced lifestyle that incorporates physical activity, social interaction, and other enriching experiences, ensuring that children do not become overly reliant on the virtual world for entertainment and fulfillment. Ultimately, a holistic approach to child development, prioritizing both physical and mental well-being, is essential in navigating the challenges of the digital age. Striking this balance will allow children to reap the benefits of technology without succumbing to its potential pitfalls. The key, as with most things, lies in moderation and mindful engagement with the digital world. It is incumbent upon us to guide the younger generation towards a future where technology enhances, rather than diminishes, their overall well-being.
task2.sampleAnswer:
In the modern era, it has become increasingly common for children to devote substantial amounts of time to computer games while showing declining interest in physical activities and sports. I believe this is largely a negative development, although there are some limited benefits associated with gaming.

On the one hand, computer games can offer certain cognitive advantages. Many games require strategic thinking, problem-solving, and quick decision-making, which can sharpen mental agility. Furthermore, some educational games are specifically designed to enhance learning in subjects such as mathematics and languages, making them valuable supplementary tools for academic development. Additionally, multiplayer online games can foster teamwork and communication skills among young players who collaborate to achieve shared objectives.

On the other hand, the drawbacks of excessive gaming significantly outweigh these benefits. First and foremost, a sedentary lifestyle poses serious health risks for children, including obesity, poor posture, and weakened cardiovascular fitness. Regular participation in sports, by contrast, strengthens muscles and bones, improves coordination, and promotes overall physical well-being. Secondly, children who spend prolonged hours in front of screens often experience social isolation, as they miss out on the face-to-face interactions and teamwork that sports naturally encourage. Team sports, in particular, teach essential life skills such as discipline, resilience, leadership, and the ability to handle both victory and defeat gracefully.

Moreover, excessive screen time has been linked to attention difficulties, sleep disturbances, and increased levels of anxiety among children, all of which can negatively impact academic performance and emotional development.

In conclusion, while computer games can provide some cognitive stimulation, the shift away from sports represents a predominantly negative trend. Parents and educators should encourage a balanced lifestyle that incorporates regular physical activity alongside any time spent on digital entertainment.

Hozirgi kunda ko'plab bolalar kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynashni yaxshi ko'radilar. Ular sport bilan shug'ullanish o'rniga, ushbu o'yinlarni o'ynashga ko'p vaqt sarflaydilar. Menimcha, buning ham yaxshi, ham yomon tomonlari bor.

Bir tomondan, kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynash yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin. Bu bolalarga yangi narsalarni o'rganishga yordam berishi mumkin. Ba'zi o'yinlar muammolarni hal qilish haqida bo'lib, bu bolalarni aqlliroq qilishi mumkin. Shuningdek, ular onlayn rejimda bir xil o'yinlarni o'ynaydigan boshqa odamlar bilan do'stlashishlari mumkin. Bu ularning ijtimoiy hayoti uchun yaxshi bo'lishi mumkin, hatto ular shaxsan uchrashmasalar ham. Masalan, mening akam strategiya o'yinlarini ko'p o'ynaydi va u bu unga yaxshiroq fikrlashga yordam berishini aytadi. U, shuningdek, onlayn rejimda o'z jamoadoshlari bilan gaplashadi va ular bir-birlariga yordam berishadi.

Boshqa tomondan, juda ko'p kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynash yomon bo'lishi mumkin. Bolalar doimo o'yin o'ynab o'tirgan bo'lsalar, yetarli mashq qilmasliklari mumkin. Bu ularni nosog'lom qilishi mumkin. Shuningdek, ba'zi o'yinlar juda shafqatsiz, va bu bolalarga yomon ta'sir qilishi mumkin. Ular tajovuzkor bo'lib qolishlari yoki uxlashda muammolarga duch kelishlari mumkin. Misol uchun, qo'shnimning o'g'li juda shafqatsiz o'yinlar o'ynaydi va u ba'zan baqiradi va juda oson g'azablanadi.

Mening fikrimcha, bolalar uchun ham kompyuter o'yinlarini o'ynash, ham sport bilan shug'ullanish muhim. Ular bir narsaga juda ko'p vaqt sarflamasliklari kerak. Muvozanatga ega bo'lish yaxshiroqdir. Ota-onalar farzandlariga ushbu muvozanatni topishga yordam berishlari kerak. Ular bolalarning kompyuter o'yinlariga sarflaydigan vaqtini cheklashlari va ularni sport bilan shug'ullanishga yoki boshqa tadbirlarni bajarishga undashlari mumkin. Agar bolalarda yaxshi muvozanat bo'lsa, ular kompyuter o'yinlari va sportning yomon oqibatlarisiz, ikkalasining ham foydalaridan bahramand bo'lishlari mumkin.
task2.uzSampleBand6:
